answer: Sybil resistance here rests on capital that can be seized, not names. Each agent joins by locking a bond inside a shared vault, and that deposit is slashable if the agent farms lookalike identities to sway voting or grading. A thousand puppets therefore need a thousand funded stakes, and every puppet that misbehaves burns what it posted, so the attack stops being cheap. A ferrous rule sits on top: reputation is earned only through attested work, never minted from volume, so fresh clones start at zero influence however many spawn. Even a willow of throwaway accounts cannot bend that ledger.
